centralGoal: Turn AI into a high-quality production assistant with critical human oversight for strategic communication.
evaluationCriteria: Strategic relevance of produced content (publishable by a brand?)
Critical thinking about AI limits during restitution
guardrails: AI is an assistant, not the final source of ideas
Avoid generic AI writing style and empty phrasing

blocks.title: Prompt foundations & strategic copy
blocks.subtitle: 3h — Written course + hands-on workshop
objectives: Structure a brief: Role, Context, Objective, Constraints, Format
Define tone of voice and editorial charter
Turn a press release into LinkedIn/Instagram posts
workshopPrompts: Transform this press release into a punchy LinkedIn thread (3 posts).
Rewrite this draft removing generic AI phrasing.
blocks.sampleBrief: Corporate client launching a sustainable mobility service for urban professionals.

blocks.title: Art direction & visual production
blocks.subtitle: 3h — Written course + hands-on workshop
objectives: Describe styles, angles, lighting, palettes in prompts
Produce campaign visuals respecting brand constraints
Discuss legal and ethical limits of AI imagery
workshopPrompts: Create carousel key visuals for the campaign from block 1.
Critique this visual for brand fit and AI clichés.
blocks.sampleBrief: Banner and carousel assets for the LinkedIn campaign.

blocks.title: Short video & declination logic
blocks.subtitle: 3h — Written course + hands-on workshop
objectives: Structure a 30-second script: hook, body, CTA
Decline a long article into video script + infographic outline
workshopPrompts: Turn this 1000-word article into a dynamic 30s script.
Storyboard three shots for the hook.
blocks.sampleBrief: 30s Reel script promoting the mobility launch.

blocks.title: Agency sprint & critical review
blocks.subtitle: 3h — Rush + Grand Oral
objectives: Deploy a full content ecosystem under time pressure
Justify tool choices and human finishing
Present with critical restitution (not AI magic)
blocks.sampleBrief: Pick a crisis scenario and deliver a multi-format kit in 2 hours.

atelier.title: Practice workshop
atelier.focus: Blocks 1–3: voice-led scenarios and multi-tool deliverables
atelier.expectedDeliverable: Revised proposal after AI critique and human improvement

interactionScripts.1: Critique the draft for strategic fit, AI clichés, and visual/script coherence.
interactionScripts.2: Guide one concrete revision path and quality checklist for publish-ready output.
